parameters.formDescription: Manually start a follow-up sequence for a lead

options.formSubmittedText: Sequence has been started for this lead.

parameters.jsCode:
// Hot Lead Sequence - Aggressive follow-up (7 steps over 10 days)
const lead = $input.first().json;

const sequence = {
  sequenceId: `seq_${Date.now()}_hot`,
  sequenceType: 'hot',
  sequenceName: 'Hot Lead - Aggressive Follow-up',
  leadEmail: lead.email || lead['Lead Email'],
  leadName: lead.fullName || lead['Lead Name'] || lead.name,
  company: lead.company || lead.Company || '',
  leadScore: lead.leadScore || lead['Lead Score'] || 85,
  phone: lead.phone || '',
  salesRep: lead.salesRep || lead['Sales Rep Email'] || '',
  notes: lead.notes || lead.Notes || '',
  
  steps: [
    {
      step: 1,
      channel: 'email',
      template: 'hot_initial',
      subject: 'Quick question about {{company}}',
      delayHours: 0,
      description: 'Initial personalized outreach'
    },
    {
      step: 2,
      channel: 'call',
      template: 'hot_call_1',
      delayHours: 4,
      description: 'Same-day follow-up call'
    },
    {
      step: 3,
      channel: 'email',
      template: 'hot_followup_1',
      subject: 'Following up on my call',
      delayHours: 24,
      description: 'Day 2 - Call follow-up email'
    },
    {
      step: 4,
      channel: 'linkedin',
      template: 'hot_linkedin',
      delayHours: 48,
      description: 'Day 3 - LinkedIn connection + message'
    },
    {
      step: 5,
      channel: 'email',
      template: 'hot_value',
      subject: 'Thought you might find this valuable',
      delayHours: 96,
      description: 'Day 5 - Value-add content'
    },
    {
      step: 6,
      channel: 'call',
      template: 'hot_call_2',
      delayHours: 168,
      description: 'Day 8 - Second call attempt'
    },
    {
      step: 7,
      channel: 'email',
      template: 'hot_breakup',
      subject: 'Should I close your file?',
      delayHours: 240,
      description: 'Day 11 - Break-up email'
    }
  ],
  
  currentStep: 0,
  totalSteps: 7,
  status: 'active',
  createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  lastActionAt: null,
  nextActionAt: new Date().toISOString()
};

return { json: sequence };

// Cold Lead Sequence - Nurture (5 steps over 30 days)
const lead = $input.first().json;

const sequence = {

// Re-engagement Sequence - Win back stale leads (4 steps over 21 days)
const lead = $input.first().json;

const sequence = {
